meta.name: director-readiness-advisor
meta.description: Guide the PM-to-Director transition across preparing, interviewing, landing, and recalibrating. Use when leadership scope is changing and you need practical coaching.

copy.tagline: 指导从产品经理到总监的晋升过渡
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从PM向总监晋升，需要实战指导。
copy.tagline_en: Guide the transition from PM to Director with practical coaching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from PM to Director and need hands-on guidance.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过提问诊断你处于 PM 转总监的哪个阶段（准备、面试、刚上任或调整），然后给出针对性的实战建议。
howto.when: 当你提到 PM 转总监、领导力转型或管理范围变化时，Claude 会主动引导对话。

say.text: 我准备在3个月内面试总监岗位，帮我做面试准备。
say.note: Claude 会询问你的面试背景和准备重点，然后给出建议。

say.text: 我刚升总监60天，还在做PM的活，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会诊断你的挑战和团队情况，给出具体行动建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will diagnose which stage of the PM-to-Director transition you are in (preparing, interviewing, newly landed, or recalibrating) and provide targeted, practical coaching.
howto.when_en: When you mention PM-to-Director transition, leadership scope change, or need coaching on moving into a Director role, Claude will initiate the conversation.

say_en.text: I'm preparing for Director interviews in 3 months. Help me prep.
I'm 60 days into a Director role and still doing PM work. What should I do?
